hotel_classification.note: The brief does not say how hotel counts. City of Vancouver zoning generally treats hotel as a commercial (non-residential) use; the tool reports the 9.0 FSR check both ways and states which it used. Grade C until a City source is cited.

land_price.note: The brief describes a hypothetical site and gives no land price: land is a user input.
